reports.text: سيول في حي المنشية، المياه وصلت لمتر ونص وفيه عيلة محبوسة في الدور الثاني ومعاهم كبير سن بيتنفس بصعوبة. 01000000001
Flash flood at Manshiya district, water about 1.5m, a family stuck on 2nd floor, elderly person struggling to breathe.
Need drinking water and baby formula at Agami shelter school, about 120 people, since yesterday.
Road blocked by fallen electricity pole on Corniche near Stanley bridge. Live wire in water. Nobody hurt yet.
BREAKING!!! dam collapsed in Alexandria, thousands dead, share now!!!
Clinic in Sidi Gaber lost power, 6 dialysis patients waiting, generator fuel ends in 3 hours.

incidents.summary: A flood in Manshiya district has trapped a family on the second floor, with an elderly person having difficulty breathing.
A flash flood in Manshiya district has trapped a family on the second floor, with an elderly person struggling to breathe.
A request for drinking water and baby formula for approximately 120 people at the Agami shelter school.
A fallen electricity pole has blocked the road on the Corniche near Stanley Bridge, with a live wire in the water.
A reported dam collapse in Alexandria with claims of thousands of deaths.
The clinic in Sidi Gaber has lost power, leaving six dialysis patients waiting as generator fuel will run out in three hours.

stages.verification:
Manshiya district – rescue (family trapped on 2nd floor, elderly having difficulty breathing) – VERIFIED: two independent reports (call and social) give matching details.  
Agami shelter school – water / baby‑formula for ~120 people – VERIFIED: specific request with numbers from a direct SMS source.  
Corniche near Stanley Bridge – hazard (fallen electricity pole, live wire in water) – UNVERIFIED: only a single social‑media post; needs confirmation.  
Alexandria – dam‑collapse claim (thousands dead) – RUMOUR: extreme death toll, vague location, no corroborating source.  
Sidi Gaber clinic – medical (power loss affecting 6 dialysis patients, generator fuel runs out in 3 h) – VERIFIED: direct call report with precise figures.
stages.triage:
P1 – Manshiya district – family trapped on 2nd floor with an elderly person struggling to breathe (immediate life‑threatening).  
P2 – Sidi Gaber clinic – power loss endangers 6 dialysis patients; generator fuel will run out in ~3 hours.  
P3 – Agami shelter school – ~120 people need water and baby‑formula (essential but not an immediate threat).
stages.dispatch:
P1 – Manshiya district – nearest rescue: Montaza Civil Defence Station, 4.5 km – First safe action: Deploy a rapid‑response rescue team with a stretcher and oxygen kit; assess structural stability before entry. Hazard to check: building collapse risk.

P2 – Sidi Gaber clinic – nearest electric: Electricity Emergency Unit – Smouha, 1.2 km – First safe action: Send a generator‑fuel resupply crew with backup power cables; verify safe electrical isolation before connecting. Hazard to check: potential fuel spill or electrocution.

P3 – Agami shelter school – nearest water: Water Tanker Depot – Moharam Bek, 12.9 km – First safe action: Dispatch water tankers with bottled water and baby‑formula; set up a clean‑water distribution point away from any flood‑prone zones. Hazard to check: sand‑storm dust affecting water quality.
stages.communication:
إلى فرق الإنقاذ: عائلة محاصرة بالمنشية، خطر انهيار. أرسلوا فريقًا سريعًا مع نقالة وأكسجين. سيدي جابر: عطل كهربائي، 6 مرضى غسيل. وفروا مولد ووقود فورًا.

Rescue: Family trapped Manshiya, collapse risk – send rapid team, stretcher & O2. Sidi Gaber clinic: power out, 6 dialysis pts – deliver generator & fuel now.

شائعة: انهيار سد بالإسكندرية وموت آلاف شخص غير صحيحة. لا توجد تقارير مؤكدة. تابعوا المصادر الرسمية فقط.

Rumor: Alexandria dam collapse with thousands dead is false. No such incident confirmed. Stay tuned to official sources.
